title: How to Glow Up: A Realistic 30-Day Plan to Reset Your Life
description: The “glow up” has been all over our feeds for years — dramatic before-and-afters, new haircuts, new wardrobes, new everything. But here’s what those clips don’t show: the boring, beautiful middle. The quiet mornings. The tiny decisions. The days you almost didn’t, and then did. A real glow up isn’t about becoming someone else. It’s about becoming more fully yourself — healthier, calmer, more confident, and more intentional about how you live. If you’re ready to learn how to glow up in a way that actually lasts, this 30-day plan breaks it into four manageable weeks. No extreme overhauls. No guilt. Just small, stackable changes that add up.
